app.setup.title_default.why: Terse ContentUnavailableView title, Apple System Settings register, states the missing condition rather than an instruction.

app.setup.title_failed.why: Hedged rather than certain, reads clearly distinct from the plain not-yet-on title.

app.setup.detail_default.s: Con la protezione attiva, i siti non possono più dirottare i clic.
app.setup.detail_default.back: With protection active, sites can no longer hijack clicks.
app.setup.detail_default.why: One-sentence payoff, impersonal (no explicit tu), fits the two-line wrap budget.

app.setup.detail_failed.s: Non è stato possibile verificare Safari. Se attivi l'estensione, verrà rilevata da sola.
app.setup.detail_failed.back: Could not verify with Safari. If you turn on the extension, it will be detected on its own.
app.setup.detail_failed.why: Two clauses, no raw error code, reassures without technical jargon.

app.setup.open_button.why: Imperative-style Apple button verb + object, works verbatim on both the setup screen and the welcome sheet.

app.welcome.heading.why: The one place allowed a warmer register; a first hello naming the product.

app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.tit.why: Plain concrete noun phrase naming the trick, not marketing language.

app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.s: Uno strato invisibile può coprire la pagina e intercettare la pressione.
app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.back: An invisible layer can cover the page and intercept the press.
app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.why: Describes what the person would see, using 'pressione' consistently for the 'press' concept.

app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.title.why: Short concrete tag naming the trick.

app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.s: Alcuni link cambiano destinazione nell'istante tra pressione e rilascio.
app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.back: Some links change destination in the instant between press and release.
app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.why: Plain description of the mid-press swap, without naming the underlying mechanism.

app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.ti.why: Concrete noun phrase naming the trick.

app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.s: Con la protezione attiva, si apre solo la scheda che hai scelto.
app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.back: With protection active, only the tab you chose opens.
app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.why: Stated as a promise about the outcome, not a description of the trick itself.

app.welcome.feature.every_destination.ti.why: Names the rule-list feature: every destination gets tracked, not just the caught ones.

app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.s: Ogni destinazione diventa una riga che puoi consentire o bloccare.
app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.back: Every destination becomes a row you can allow or block.
app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.why: Explains the review-and-decide mechanism in one plain sentence.

app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.t.why: Idiomatic Italian phrase for the per-site activation model.

app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.s: Premi il pulsante Undirect nella barra di Safari su quel sito.
app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.back: Press the Undirect button in Safari's toolbar on that site.
app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.why: States the exact mechanism: the toolbar button, on the site in question.

app.nav.guarded_sites.why: Short enough for the sidebar column and identical as the screen's nav title.

app.nav.settings.why: Apple's own term for this screen on both iOS and macOS.

app.nav.app_title.why: Proper noun, left untranslated like any other app's own name.

app.rules.grouping.everywhere.why: One word, reads as a clear opposite of 'Per sito' beside it.

app.rules.empty_no_app.title.why: Names the wiring/first-contact state, distinct from an empty rules list.

app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.s: Apri una pagina in Safari e i dati appariranno.
app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.back: Open a page in Safari and the data will appear.
app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.why: States the simple fix: one ordinary use of Safari, no setting to change.

app.rules.empty_no_rules.title.why: Plain statement that this particular list is empty, contrasted with the first-contact state above.

app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.s: Una regola compare solo dopo una decisione.
app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.back: A rule appears only after a decision.
app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.why: Explains that a rule needs an explicit allow/block choice, not merely being seen.

app.rules.footer.lifetime_count.why: Placeholder kept as %lld; plural agreement of the surrounding number is handled by the platform's own plural rule.

app.rules.row.state_blocked.why: One word, opposite of 'Consentito' when the two sit in the same list.

app.rules.row.action_allow.why: Imperative action verb, distinct from the state noun/adjective 'Consentito'.

app.rules.row.action_block.why: Imperative action verb, shown only when the row is currently Allowed.

app.rules.row.help_tooltip.back: Choose whether to allow or block.
app.rules.row.help_tooltip.why: Short hover tooltip describing the control under the pointer.

app.rules.row.use_default.why: Names clearing the explicit rule so the default policy applies again.

app.watched.empty.title.why: States plainly that no site has been switched on yet.

app.watched.empty.detail.s: Premi il pulsante Undirect nella barra di Safari su un sito problematico.
app.watched.empty.detail.back: Press the Undirect button in Safari's toolbar on a problem site.
app.watched.empty.detail.why: Tells the person exactly how to guard their first site.

app.watched.footer.s: Aggiungi altri siti dal pulsante Undirect in Safari.
app.watched.footer.back: Add more sites from the Undirect button in Safari.
app.watched.footer.why: Reminds where new entries come from, since this screen cannot add one itself.

app.watched.row.guarded_badge.why: Read-only status word, not a button.

app.watched.row.stop_button.why: Short imperative verb for the trailing row button that switches guarding off.

app.watched.row.stop_tooltip.s: Disattiva la protezione su questo sito.
app.watched.row.stop_tooltip.why: Describes what the Stop button under the pointer does.

app.settings.guard_toggle.why: The one-word noun used as the master switch label and as the recurring 'guard' concept.

app.settings.state_on.why: Generic on-state adjective, reused for more than one setting on this screen.

app.settings.state_off.why: Feminine adjective agreeing with 'Protezione'/'Nota', clear opposite of 'Attiva'.

app.settings.mode_heading.why: Introduces the choice of which sites the guard runs on.

app.settings.mode_watched.why: Described from the person's point of view: sites they switched on themselves.

app.settings.mode_everywhere.why: Names the always-on mode with no per-site switching needed.

app.settings.banner_toggle.why: Matches the vocabulary term for the on-page banner, kept consistent with the extension's own setting.

app.settings.policy_heading.s: Criterio per le destinazioni senza regola
app.settings.policy_heading.back: Policy for destinations without a rule
app.settings.policy_heading.why: Introduces the default-policy choice for any unrated destination.

app.settings.policy_block.why: Short imperative picker option, clear opposite of 'Consenti'.

app.settings.policy_allow.why: Short imperative picker option, clear opposite of 'Blocca'.

ext.meta.name.why: Proper noun in the Extensions list and App Store, left untranslated.

ext.meta.description.s: Impedisce alle pagine di usare i tuoi clic per aprire o reindirizzare altrove.
ext.meta.description.back: Stops pages from using your clicks to open or redirect elsewhere.
ext.meta.description.why: One plain sentence for someone who has never used the extension, no jargon.

ext.meta.app_title.why: Fallback display name for the product itself when no site name is available.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_on.why: States that guarding is currently on for the tab's site.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_off.back: Protection off: press to activate it
ext.toolbar.tooltip_off.why: Doubles as the call to action, since pressing the icon is how guarding turns on.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_no_site.why: Explains there is nothing for the extension to do on this tab.

ext.popup.no_site_title.why: Short headline for the empty state on a tab with no website open.

ext.popup.no_site_body.s: Apri un sito e premi qui per proteggerlo.
ext.popup.no_site_body.back: Open a site and press here to protect it.
ext.popup.no_site_body.why: 'Qui' keeps the self-reference to the toolbar button the popup hangs off, rather than translating 'here' as a place.

ext.popup.watch_switch_label.s: Attiva o disattiva la protezione per questo sito
ext.popup.watch_switch_label.back: Turn protection for this site on or off
ext.popup.watch_switch_label.why: Screen-reader-only label naming what the switch controls, since the visible row already shows the site name.

ext.popup.watch_unknown.why: Explains why the per-site switch is disabled: there is no real page.

ext.popup.watch_everywhere_mode.why: Explains the switch is redundant because 'everywhere' mode is already on.

ext.popup.watch_master_off.why: Explains the switch is disabled because the master guard is off, not because of this site.

ext.popup.watch_on.s: Attiva qui: disattivarla ricarica la pagina.
ext.popup.watch_on.back: Active here: turning it off reloads the page.
ext.popup.watch_on.why: Confirms the current state and warns about the reload, mirroring watch_off's shape.

ext.popup.watch_off.s: Disattivata qui: attivarla ricarica la pagina.
ext.popup.watch_off.back: Off here: turning it on reloads the page.
ext.popup.watch_off.why: Direct before/after counterpart to watch_on, same sentence shape.

ext.popup.page_heading.why: Names the section listing what the current tab specifically reached for.

ext.popup.page_off.why: Speculative wording for a currently-unused key, matching the voice of the other page-section states.

ext.popup.page_quiet.s: Nessun tentativo su questa pagina finora.
ext.popup.page_quiet.back: No attempt on this page so far.
ext.popup.page_quiet.why: States plainly that nothing has reached outside this page yet.

ext.popup.page_empty.why: Near-synonym of page_quiet, for a currently-unused, near-duplicate key.

ext.popup.stopped_one.why: Singular form paired with stopped_other; placeholder kept as given.

ext.popup.stopped_other.why: Plural form, agrees in number with the destinations counted.

ext.popup.seen_one.why: Broader than 'stopped': counts every recorded attempt, blocked and allowed together.

ext.popup.tries_one.why: Terse per-destination fragment meant to sit among other short tags in one detail line.

ext.popup.recipe_heading.why: One-word lead-in fragment for 'Correzione: <name>', naming the applied per-site fix.

ext.state.blocked.why: Reused status word; combines with a following scope fragment, e.g. 'Bloccato ovunque'.

ext.state.allowed.why: Reused status word, clear opposite of 'Bloccato', same combination rule.

ext.state.removed.why: Names a trap taken off the page itself, where there is no destination to rule on.

ext.scope.here.why: Fragment composed after a verdict word, e.g. 'Bloccato su questo sito'.

ext.scope.everywhere.why: Fragment composed after a verdict word, e.g. 'Bloccato ovunque'.

ext.scope.default.why: Fragment composed after a verdict word, e.g. 'Bloccato per impostazione predefinita', avoiding the English loanword 'default'.

ext.action.allow_here.why: Menu option scoped to the current site only.

ext.action.allow_everywhere.why: Menu option scoped to every guarded site.

ext.action.block_here.why: Menu option scoped to the current site only.

ext.action.block_everywhere.why: Menu option scoped to every guarded site.

ext.popup.policy_heading.s: Criterio per le destinazioni senza regola
ext.popup.policy_heading.back: Policy for destinations without a rule
ext.popup.policy_heading.why: Same concept and wording as the app's settings equivalent, for a user moving between the two.

ext.popup.bridge_warning.s: Le impostazioni di sicurezza di questa pagina bloccano parte della protezione.
ext.popup.bridge_warning.back: This page's security settings block part of protection.
ext.popup.bridge_warning.why: Names the page's own CSP as the limitation, not a bug or a setting to fix.

ext.kind.click_catcher.why: Terse tag distinguishing the clickable catcher from the broader overlay case below.

ext.kind.overlay.why: Broader than the click-catcher tag: any see-through element over the page.

ext.kind.synthetic_click.why: Names a click the page's own script dispatched, not a real press.

ext.kind.window_open.why: Names a window the page opened through its own code.

ext.kind.form_submit.why: Names the hidden-form-submit trick used to open a new tab.

ext.kind.href_swap.why: Names the mid-press link-swap trick plainly.

ext.kind.back_hijack.why: Names a navigation fired right after the browser's back gesture.

ext.kind.redirect.why: Names the core same-tab-redirect trick concisely, chosen shorter over the longer literal phrasing.

ext.kind.pop_tab.why: Names a tab-under style new tab opened behind the press.

ext.kind.network_rule.why: Names the earliest, strongest kind of block: refused at the request itself.

ext.reason.way_back.s: L'indirizzo include un ritorno al sito.
ext.reason.way_back.back: The address includes a way back to the site.
ext.reason.way_back.why: Explains the redirect was allowed because its own address carried a path back.

ext.reason.sized.why: Explains the window was allowed because it asked for a deliberate size, not a bare tab.

ext.reason.took_press.why: Very short footnote using the consistent 'pressione' term for the core hijack pattern.

ext.reason.default_allow.why: Very short footnote explaining the destination went through with no rule against it.

ext.reason.own_code.s: Aperta dal codice del sito stesso.
ext.reason.own_code.back: Opened by the site's own code.
ext.reason.own_code.why: Explains the window was allowed because the site itself vouched for it.

ext.popup.rules_link.why: Reused as the nav row, the screen's own header, and the back-button's accessible label.

ext.popup.back_link.why: Apple's own idiom for a chevron-only back button's accessible label.

ext.rules.everywhere_heading.why: Matches app.rules.grouping.everywhere for the same concept across surfaces.

ext.rules.by_site_heading.why: Matches app.rules.grouping.by_site for the same concept across surfaces.

ext.action.allow.why: Simple menu option; scope is already fixed by the section the row sits in.

ext.action.block.why: Simple menu option; scope is already fixed by the section the row sits in.

ext.action.clear.why: Same underlying action as app.rules.row.use_default, phrased for the tighter popup menu.

ext.popup.settings_heading.why: Reused as both the nav row and the sub-screen's own header title.

ext.settings.guard_label.why: Extension-side counterpart to app.settings.guard_toggle, same word for the master switch.

ext.settings.guard_on.why: State label for the master guard switch when it is on.

ext.settings.guard_off.why: State label for the master guard switch when it is off.

ext.settings.banner_toggle.why: Extension-side counterpart to app.settings.banner_toggle, trimmed for the tighter popup row.

ext.action.report.why: Names opening a pre-filled issue report; nothing is sent until the person submits it themselves.
